title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Calculation - Calories
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A solution of Dextrose 50% (D50) provides 3.4 kcal/gram of dextrose. How many calories are in 500 ml of D50?
questions.explain: D50 means 50g dextrose per 100ml. So 500ml contains $$5 \times 50 = 250\text{g}$$ dextrose. Calories = $$250\text{g} \times 3.4\text{ kcal/g} = 850\text{ kcal}$$. Note: Hydrous dextrose is 3.4 kcal/g.
